Musalmaano! Jin mushrikeen se tum ne ahd o paimaan kiya tha ab un se Khuda o Rasool ki taraf se mukammal bezaari ka e'laan hai
Lihaaza kaafiro! Chaar maheene tak aazaadi se zameen mein sair karo aur yeh yaad rakho ke Khuda se bach kar nahin ja sakte, aur Khuda kaafiron ko zaleel karne waala hai

Aur Allah o Rasool ki taraf se Hajj-e-Akbar ke din insaanon ke liye e'laan-e-aam hai ke Allah aur us ke Rasool donon mushrikeen se bezaar hain. Lihaaza agar tum tauba kar loge to tumhaare haq mein behtar hai, aur agar inhiraaf kiya to yaad rakhna ke tum Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte ho. Aur Paighambar! Aap kaafiron ko dardnaak azaab ki bashaarat de dijiye

Ilaawa un afraad ke jin se tum Musalmaanon ne mu'aahida kar rakha hai aur unhon ne koi kotaahi nahin ki hai aur tumhaare khilaaf ek doosre ki madad nahin ki hai, to chaar maheene ke bajaaye jo muddat tai ki hai us waqt tak ahd ko poora karo, ke Khuda taqwa ikhtiyaar karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai

Phir jab yeh mohtaram maheene guzar jaayein to kuffaar ko jahaan paao qatl kar do aur giraft mein le lo aur qaid kar do, aur har raaste aur guzargaah par un ke liye baith jaao aur raasta tang kar do. Phir agar tauba kar lein aur namaaz qaaim karein aur zakaat ada karein to un ka raasta chhod do, ke Khuda bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur agar mushrikeen mein koi tum se panaah maange to use panaah de do taake woh kitaab-e-Khuda sune, us ke baad use aazaad kar ke jahaan us ki panaahgaah ho wahaan tak pahuncha do, aur yeh muraa'aat is liye hai ke yeh jaahil qaum haqaaiq se aashna nahin hai

Allah o Rasool ke nazdeek ahd-shikan mushrikeen ka koi ahd o paimaan kis tarah qaaim reh sakta hai? Haan agar tum logon ne kisi se Masjid-ul-Haraam ke nazdeek ahd kar liya hai to jab tak woh log apne ahd par qaaim rahein tum bhi qaaim raho, ke Allah muttaqi aur parhezgaar afraad ko dost rakhta hai

Un ke saath kis tarah ri'aayat ki jaaye jab ke yeh tum par ghaalib aa jaayein to na kisi hamsaaegi aur qaraabat ki nigraani karenge aur na koi ahd o paimaan dekhenge. Yeh to sirf zabaani tum ko khush kar rahe hain warna un ka dil qat'i munkir hai, aur un ki aksariyat faasiq aur bad-ahd hai
Unhon ne aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ke badle bahut thodi manfa'at ko le liya hai aur ab raah-e-Khuda se rok rahe hain. Yeh bahut bura kaam kar rahe hain
Yeh kisi momin ke baare mein kisi qaraabat ya qaul o iqraar ki parwa nahin karte hain, yeh sirf ziyaadati karne waale log hain

Phir bhi agar yeh tauba kar lein aur namaaz qaaim karein aur zakaat ada karein to deen mein tumhaare bhaai hain, aur hum saahibaan-e-ilm ke liye apni aayaat ko tafseel ke saath bayaan karte rehte hain

Aur agar yeh ahd ke baad bhi apni qasmon ko tod dein aur deen mein ta'na-zani karein to kufr ke sarbaraahon se khul kar jihaad karo, ke un ki qasmon ka koi e'tebaar nahin hai, shaayad yeh isi tarah apni harkaton se baaz aa jaayein

Kya tum us qaum se jihaad na karoge jis ne apne ahd o paimaan ko tod diya hai aur Rasool ko watan se nikaal dene ka iraada bhi kar liya hai, aur tumhaare muqaable mein mazaalim ki pehal bhi ki hai? Kya tum un se darte ho? To Khuda ziyaada haqdaar hai ke us ka khauf paida karo agar tum saahib-e-imaan ho
Un se jang karo, Allah inhein tumhaare haathon se saza dega aur ruswa karega aur tumhein un par fatah ata karega, aur saahib-e-imaan qaum ke dilon ko thanda kar dega
Aur un ke dilon ka ghussa door kar dega, aur Allah jis ki tauba ko chaahta hai qubool kar leta hai, ke woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Kya tumhaara khayaal yeh hai ke tum ko isi tarah chhod diya jaaega, jab ke Allah ne abhi yeh bhi nahin dekha hai ke tum mein jihaad karne waale kaun log hain, jinhon ne Khuda, Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko chhod kar kisi ko dost nahin banaaya hai? Aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Yeh kaam mushrikeen ka nahin hai ke woh masaajid-e-Khuda ko aabaad karein jab ke woh khud apne nafs ke kufr ke gawaah hain. Un ke aamaal barbaad hain aur woh Jahannam mein hamesha rehne waale hain

Allah ki masjidon ko sirf woh log aabaad karte hain jin ka imaan Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par hai, aur jinhon ne namaaz qaaim ki hai, zakaat ada ki hai, aur siwaaye Khuda ke kisi se nahin dare. Yahi woh log hain jo anqareeb hidaayat-yaafta logon mein shumaar kiye jaayenge

Kya tum ne haajiyon ke paani pilaane aur Masjid-ul-Haraam ki aabaadi ko us ke jaisa samajh liya hai jo Allah aur aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai aur raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karta hai? Hargiz yeh donon Allah ke nazdeek baraabar nahin ho sakte, aur Allah zaalim qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai
Beshak jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne hijrat ki aur raah-e-Khuda mein jaan aur maal se jihaad kiya, woh Allah ke nazdeek azeem darje ke maalik hain aur dar-haqeeqat wahi kaamyaab bhi hain
Allah un ko apni rehmat, razaamandi aur baaghaat ki bashaarat deta hai jahaan un ke liye daaimi ne'matein hongi
Woh unhi baaghaat mein hamesha rahenge, ke Allah ke paas azeem-tareen ajr hai

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar apne baap daada aur bhaaiyon ko apna dost na banaao agar woh imaan ke muqaable mein kufr ko dost rakhte hon, aur jo shakhs bhi aise logon ko apna dost banaaega woh zaalimon mein shumaar hoga

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke agar tumhaare baap daada, aulaad, biraadaraan, azwaaj, asheera o qabeela, aur woh amwaal jinhein tum ne jama kiya hai, aur woh tijaarat jis ke khasaare ki taraf se fikrmand rehte ho, aur woh makaanaat jinhein pasand karte ho, tumhaari nigaah mein Allah, us ke Rasool aur raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad se ziyaada mehboob hain, to waqt ka intizaar karo yahaan tak ke amr-e-Ilaahi aa jaaye, aur Allah faasiq qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Beshak Allah ne kaseer maqaamaat par tumhaari madad ki hai, aur Hunain ke din bhi jab tumhein apni kasrat par naaz tha, lekin us ne tumhein koi faaida nahin pahunchaaya, aur tumhaare liye zameen apni wus'aton samet tang ho gayi, aur us ke baad tum peeth pher kar bhaag nikle

Phir us ke baad Khuda ne apne Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan par sukoon naazil kiya, aur woh lashkar bheje jinhein tum ne nahin dekha, aur kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon par azaab naazil kiya. Yahi kaafireen ki jaza aur un ka anjaam hai
Us ke baad Khuda jis ki chaahega tauba qubool kar lega, woh bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Imaan waalo! Mushrikeen saraasar najaasat hain, lihaaza khabardaar is saal ke baad Masjid-ul-Haraam mein daakhil na hone paayein, aur agar tumhein ghurbat ka khauf hai to anqareeb Khuda chaahega to apne fazl o karam se tumhein ghani bana dega, ke woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Un logon se jihaad karo jo Khuda aur roz-e-aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte, aur jis cheez ko Khuda o Rasool ne haraam qaraar diya hai use haraam nahin samajhte, aur ahl-e-kitaab hote hue bhi deen-e-haq ka iltizaam nahin karte, yahaan tak ke apne haathon se zillat ke saath tumhaare saamne jizya pesh karne par aamaada ho jaayein

Aur Yahoodiyon ka kehna hai ke Uzair Allah ke bete hain, aur Nasaara kehte hain ke Maseeh Allah ke bete hain. Yeh sab un ki zabaani baatein hain. In baaton mein yeh bilkul un ke misl hain jo un se pehle kuffaar kaha karte the. Allah un sab ko qatl kare, yeh kahaan behke chale ja rahe hain

Un logon ne apne aalimon aur raahibon aur Maseeh ibn-e-Maryam ko Khuda ko chhod kar apna Rab bana liya hai, haalaanke inhein sirf Khuda-e-Yakta ki ibaadat ka hukm diya gaya tha jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Woh waahid o be-niyaaz hai aur un ke mushrikaana khayaalaat se paak o paakeeza hai

Yeh log chaahte hain ke noor-e-Khuda ko apne munh se phoonk maar kar bujha dein, haalaanke Khuda is ke ilaawa kuch maanne ke liye taiyaar nahin hai ke woh apne noor ko tamaam kar de, chaahe kaafiron ko yeh kitna hi bura kyon na lage
Woh Khuda woh hai jis ne apne Rasool ko hidaayat aur deen-e-haq ke saath bheja taake apne deen ko tamaam adyaan par ghaalib banaaye, chaahe mushrikeen ko kitna hi naagawaar kyon na ho

Imaan waalo! Nasaara ke bahut se ulama aur raahib logon ke amwaal ko naajaaiz tareeqe se kha jaate hain aur logon ko raah-e-Khuda se rokte hain. Aur jo log sone chaandi ka zakheera karte hain aur use raah-e-Khuda mein kharch nahin karte, Paighambar! Aap inhein dardnaak azaab ki bashaarat de dein

Jis din woh sona chaandi aatish-e-Jahannam mein tapaaya jaaega aur us se un ki peshaaniyon aur un ke pehluon aur pusht ko daagha jaaega, ke yahi woh zakheera hai jo tum ne apne liye jama kiya tha, ab apne khazaanon aur zakheeron ka maza chakho

Beshak maheenon ki ta'daad Allah ke nazdeek kitaab-e-Khuda mein us din se baarah hai jis din us ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko paida kiya hai. Un mein se chaar maheene mohtaram hain, aur yahi seedha aur mustahkam deen hai. Lihaaza khabardaar un maheenon mein apne oopar zulm na karna, aur tamaam mushrikeen se isi tarah jihaad karna jis tarah woh tum se jang karte hain, aur yeh yaad rakhna ke Khuda sirf muttaqi aur parhezgaar logon ke saath hai

Mohtaram maheenon mein taqdeem o taakheer kufr mein ek qism ki ziyaadati hai jis ke zariye kuffaar ko gumraah kiya jaata hai, ke woh ek saal use halaal bana lete hain aur doosre saal haraam kar dete hain, taake utni ta'daad baraabar ho jaaye jitni Khuda ne haraam ki hai aur haraam-e-Khuda halaal bhi ho jaaye. Un ke badtareen aamaal ko un ki nigaah mein aaraasta kar diya gaya hai, aur Allah kaafir qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Imaan waalo! Tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke jab tum se kaha gaya ke raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad ke liye niklo to tum zameen se chipak kar reh gaye? Kya tum aakhirat ke badle zindagaani-e-duniya se raazi ho gaye ho? To yaad rakho ke aakhirat mein is mataa'-e-zindagaani-e-duniya ki haqeeqat bahut qaleel hai

Agar tum raah-e-Khuda mein na nikloge to Khuda tumhein dardnaak azaab mein mubtala karega aur tumhaare badle doosri qaum ko le aaega, aur tum use koi nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakte ho, ke woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Agar tum Paighambar ki madad na karoge to un ki madad Khuda ne ki hai, us waqt jab kuffaar ne inhein watan se baahar nikaal diya aur woh ek shakhs ke saath nikle aur donon ghaar mein the, to woh apne saathi se keh rahe the ke ranj na karo, Khuda hamaare saath hai. Phir Khuda ne apni taraf se apne Paighambar par sukoon naazil kar diya aur un ki taaeed un lashkaron se kar di jinhein tum na dekh sake, aur Allah hi ne kuffaar ke kalime ko past bana diya hai, aur Allah ka kalima dar-haqeeqat bahut buland hai, ke woh saahib-e-izzat o ghalaba bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Musalmaano! Tum halke ho ya bhaari ghar se nikal pado aur raah-e-Khuda mein apne amwaal aur nufoos se jihaad karo, ke yahi tumhaare haq mein khair hai agar tum kuch jaante ho

Paighambar! Agar koi qareebi faaida ya aasaan safar hota to yeh zaroor tumhaara ittibaa' karte, lekin un ke liye door ka safar mushkil ban gaya hai, aur anqareeb yeh Khuda ki qasam khaayenge ke agar mumkin hota to hum zaroor aap ke saath nikal padte. Yeh apne nafs ko halaak kar rahe hain aur Khuda khoob jaanta hai ke yeh jhoote hain
Paighambar! Khuda ne aap se darguzar kiya ke aap ne kyon inhein peechhe reh jaane ki ijaazat de di, baghair yeh maaloom kiye ke un mein kaun sachcha hai aur kaun jhoota hai
Jo log Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain woh hargiz apne jaan o maal se jihaad karne ke khilaaf ijaazat na talab karenge, ke Khuda saahibaan-e-taqwa ko khoob jaanta hai
Yeh ijaazat sirf woh log talab karte hain jin ka imaan Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par nahin hai aur un ke dilon mein shubha hai aur woh usi shubhe mein chakkar kaat rahe hain

Yeh agar nikalna chaahte to us ke liye saamaan taiyaar karte, lekin Khuda hi ko un ka nikalna pasand nahin hai, is liye us ne un ke iraadon ko kamzor rehne diya aur un se kaha gaya ke ab tum baithne waalon ke saath baithe raho

Agar yeh tumhaare darmiyaan nikal bhi padte to tumhaari wahshat mein izaafa hi kar dete, aur tumhaare darmiyaan fitne ki talaash mein ghode daudaate phirte, aur tum mein aise log bhi the jo un ki sunne waale bhi the, aur Allah to zaalimeen ko khoob jaanne waala hai

Beshak unhon ne is se pehle bhi fitne ki koshish ki thi aur tumhaare umoor ko ulat palat dena chaaha tha, yahaan tak ke haq aa gaya aur amr-e-Khuda waazeh ho gaya, agarche yeh log use naapasand kar rahe the

Un mein woh log bhi hain jo kehte hain ke hum ko ijaazat de dijiye aur fitne mein na daaliye. To aagaah ho jaao ke yeh waaqe'an fitne mein gir chuke hain, aur Jahannam to kaafireen ko har taraf se ihaata kiye hue hai

Un ka haal yeh hai ke aap tak neki aati hai to inhein buri lagti hai, aur koi museebat aa jaati hai to kehte hain ke hum ne apna kaam pehle hi theek kar liya tha, aur khush o khurram waapas chale jaate hain
Aap keh dijiye ke hum tak wahi haalaat aate hain jo Khuda ne hamaare haq mein likh diye hain, wahi hamaara Maula hai, aur saahibaan-e-imaan usi par tawakkul aur e'temaad rakhte hain

Aap keh dijiye ke tum hamaare baare mein jis baat ka bhi intizaar kar rahe ho woh do mein se ek neki hai, aur hum tumhaare baare mein is baat ka intizaar kar rahe hain ke Khuda apni taraf se ya hamaare haathon se tumhein azaab mein mubtala kar de. Lihaaza ab azaab ka intizaar karo, hum bhi tumhaare saath intizaar kar rahe hain
Keh dijiye ke tum ba-khushi kharch karo ya jabran, tumhaara amal qubool hone waala nahin hai, ke tum ek faasiq qaum ho

Aur un ke nafaqaat ko qubool hone se sirf is baat ne rok diya hai ke unhon ne Khuda aur Rasool ka inkaar kiya hai, aur yeh namaaz bhi susti aur kasalmandi ke saath baja laate hain, aur raah-e-Khuda mein karaahat aur naagawaari ke saath kharch karte hain
Tumhein un ke amwaal aur aulaad hairat mein na daal dein. Bas Allah ka iraada yahi hai ke unhi ke zariye un par zindagaani-e-duniya mein azaab kare aur haalat-e-kufr hi mein un ki jaan nikal jaaye
Aur yeh Allah ki qasam khaate hain ke yeh tum hi mein se hain, haalaanke yeh tum mein se nahin hain, yeh log buzdil log hain
Un ko koi panaahgaah ya ghaar ya ghus baithne ki jagah mil jaaye to us ki taraf be-tahaasha bhaag jaayenge
Aur unhi mein se woh bhi hain jo khairaat ke baare mein ilzaam lagaate hain, ke inhein kuch mil jaaye to raazi ho jaayenge aur na diya jaaye to naaraaz ho jaayenge

Haalaanke ae kaash yeh Khuda o Rasool ke diye hue par raazi ho jaate aur yeh kehte ke hamaare liye Allah hi kaafi hai, anqareeb woh aur us ka Rasool apne fazl o ehsaan se ata kar denge, aur hum to sirf Allah ki taraf raghbat rakhne waale hain

Sadaqaat o khairaat bas fuqara, masaakeen aur un ke kaam karne waale, aur jin ki taaleef-e-qalb ki jaati hai, aur ghulaamon ki gardan ki aazaadi mein, aur qarzdaaron ke liye, aur raah-e-Khuda mein, ghurbat-zada musaafiron ke liye hain. Yeh Allah ki taraf se fareeza hai aur Allah khoob jaanne waala aur hikmat waala hai

Un mein se woh bhi hain jo Paighambar ko aziyyat dete hain aur kehte hain ke woh to sirf kaan hain. Aap keh dijiye ke tumhaare haq mein behtari ke kaan hain, ke Khuda par imaan rakhte hain aur momineen ki tasdeeq karte hain, aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye rehmat hain, aur jo log Rasool-e-Khuda ko aziyyat dete hain un ke waaste dardnaak azaab hai

Yeh log tum logon ko raazi karne ke liye Khuda ki qasam khaate hain, haalaanke Khuda o Rasool is baat ke ziyaada haqdaar the ke agar yeh saahibaan-e-imaan the to waaqe'an inhein apne aamaal o kirdaar se raazi karte
Kya yeh nahin jaante hain ke jo Khuda o Rasool se mukhaalifat karega us ke liye aatish-e-Jahannam hai aur usi mein hamesha rehna hai, aur yeh bahut badi ruswaai hai

Munaafiqeen ko yeh khauf bhi hai ke kaheen koi soorah naazil ho kar Musalmaanon ko un ke dil ke haalaat se baakhabar na kar de. To aap keh dijiye ke tum aur mazaaq udaao, Allah bahar-haal us cheez ko manzar-e-aam par le aaega jis ka tumhein khatra hai
Aur agar aap un se baaz-purs karenge to kahenge ke hum to sirf baat cheet aur dil-lagi kar rahe the. To aap keh dijiye ke kya Allah aur us ki aayaat aur Rasool ke baare mein mazaaq uda rahe the
To ab ma'zarat na karo. Tum ne imaan ke baad kufr ikhtiyaar kiya hai. Hum agar tum mein ki ek jamaa'at ko maaf bhi kar dein to doosri jamaa'at par zaroor azaab karenge ke yeh log mujrim hain

Munaafiq mard aur munaafiq auratein aapas mein sab ek doosre se hain. Sab buraaiyon ka hukm dete hain aur nekiyon se rokte hain, aur apne haathon ko raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karne se roke rehte hain. Unhon ne Allah ko bhula diya hai to Allah ne inhein bhi nazar-andaaz kar diya hai, ke munaafiqeen hi asl mein faasiq hain

Aur Allah ne munaafiq mardon aur auraton se aur tamaam kaafiron se aatish-e-Jahannam ka wa'da kiya hai jis mein yeh hamesha rehne waale hain. Wahi un ke waaste kaafi hai aur un ke liye hamesha rehne waala azaab hai

Tumhaari misaal tum se pehle waalon ki hai jo tum se ziyaada taaqatwar the aur tum se ziyaada maaldaar aur saahib-e-aulaad bhi the. Unhon ne apne hisse se khoob faaida uthaaya, aur tum ne bhi isi tarah apne naseeb se faaida uthaaya jis tarah tum se pehle waalon ne uthaaya tha, aur isi tarah laghwiyaat mein daakhil hue jis tarah woh log daakhil hue the. Haalaanke wahi woh log hain jin ke aamaal duniya aur aakhirat mein barbaad ho gaye, aur wahi woh log hain jo haqeeqatan khasaare waale hain

Kya un logon ke paas un se pehle waale afraad, qaum-e-Nooh, Aad, Samood, qaum-e-Ibraheem, ashaab-e-Madyan aur ulat di jaane waali bastiyon ki khabar nahin aayi, jin ke paas un ke rasool waazeh nishaaniyaan le kar aaye aur unhon ne inkaar kar diya? Khuda kisi par zulm karne waala nahin hai, log khud apne nafs par zulm karte hain

Momin mard aur momin auratein aapas mein sab ek doosre ke waali aur madadgaar hain, ke yeh sab ek doosre ko nekiyon ka hukm dete hain aur buraaiyon se rokte hain, namaaz qaaim karte hain, zakaat ada karte hain, Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karte hain. Yahi woh log hain jin par anqareeb Khuda rehmat naazil karega, ke woh har shai par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Allah ne momin mard aur momin auraton se un baaghaat ka wa'da kiya hai jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, yeh un mein hamesha rehne waale hain. Un jannaat-e-Adn mein paakeeza makaanaat hain, aur Allah ki marzi to sab se badi cheez hai, aur yahi ek azeem kaamyaabi hai
Paighambar! Kuffaar aur munaafiqeen se jihaad kijiye aur un par sakhti kijiye ke un ka anjaam Jahannam hai jo badtareen thikaana hai

Yeh apni baaton par Allah ki qasam khaate hain ke aisa nahin kaha, haalaanke unhon ne kalima-e-kufr kaha hai aur apne Islam ke baad kaafir ho gaye hain, aur woh iraada kiya tha jo haasil nahin kar sake. Aur un ka ghussa sirf is baat par hai ke Allah aur Rasool ne apne fazl o karam se Musalmaanon ko nawaaz diya hai. Bahar-haal yeh ab bhi tauba kar lein to un ke haq mein behtar hai, aur munh pher lein to Allah un par duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnaak azaab karega aur roo-e-zameen par koi un ka sarparast aur madadgaar na hoga
Un mein woh bhi hain jinhon ne Khuda se ahd kiya ke agar woh apne fazl o karam se ata kar dega to us ki raah mein sadqa denge aur nek bandon mein shaamil ho jaayenge
Us ke baad jab Khuda ne apne fazl se ata kar diya to bukhl se kaam liya aur kinaara-kash ho kar palat gaye
To un ke bukhl ne un ke dilon mein nifaaq raasikh kar diya us din tak ke liye jab yeh Khuda se mulaaqaat karenge, is liye ke unhon ne Khuda se kiye hue wa'de ki mukhaalifat ki hai aur jhoot bole hain
Kya yeh nahin jaante ke Khuda un ke raaz-e-dil aur un ki sargoshiyon ko bhi jaanta hai, aur woh saare ghaib ka jaanne waala hai

Jo log sadaqaat mein faraakh-dili se hissa lene waale momineen aur un ghareebon par, jin ke paas un ki mehnat ke ilaawa kuch nahin hai, ilzaam lagaate hain aur phir un ka mazaaq udaate hain, Khuda un ka bhi mazaaq bana dega, aur us ke paas bada dardnaak azaab hai

Aap un ke liye istighfaar karein ya na karein, agar sattar martaba bhi istighfaar karenge to Khuda inhein bakhshne waala nahin hai, is liye ke unhon ne Allah aur Rasool ka inkaar kiya hai, aur Khuda faasiq qaum ko hidaayat nahin deta hai

Jo log jang-e-Tabook mein nahin gaye woh Rasoolullah ke peechhe baithe reh jaane par khush hain, aur inhein apne jaan o maal se raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad naagawaar maaloom hota hai, aur yeh kehte hain ke tum log garmi mein na niklo. To Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke aatish-e-Jahannam is se ziyaada garam hai, agar yeh log kuch samajhne waale hain
Ab yeh log hansein kam aur royein ziyaada, ke yahi un ke kiye ki jaza hai

Us ke baad agar Khuda aap ko un ke kisi giroh tak maidaan se waapas laaye aur yeh dobaara khurooj ki ijaazat talab karein, to aap keh dijiye tum log kabhi mere saath nahin nikal sakte aur kisi dushman se jihaad nahin kar sakte. Tum ne pehle hi baithe rehna pasand kiya tha, to ab bhi peechhe reh jaane waalon ke saath baithe raho

Aur khabardaar un mein se koi mar bhi jaaye to us ki namaaz-e-janaaza na padhiyega, aur us ki qabr par khade bhi na hoiyega, ke un logon ne Khuda aur Rasool ka inkaar kiya hai aur haalat-e-fisq mein duniya se guzar gaye hain
Aur un ke amwaal o aulaad aap ko bhale na maaloom hon. Khuda un ke zariye un par duniya mein azaab karna chaahta hai aur chaahta hai ke kufr ki haalat mein un ka dam nikal jaaye

Aur jab koi soorah naazil hota hai ke Allah par imaan le aao aur Rasool ke saath jihaad karo, to unhi ke saahibaan-e-haisiyat aap se ijaazat talab karne lagte hain aur kehte hain ke humein unhi baithne waalon ke saath chhod dijiye
Yeh is baat par raazi hain ke peechhe reh jaane waalon ke saath reh jaayein. Un ke dilon par mohr lag gayi hai, ab yeh kuch samajhne waale nahin hain
Lekin Rasool aur un ke saath imaan laane waalon ne raah-e-Khuda mein apne jaan o maal se jihaad kiya hai, aur unhi ke liye nekiyaan hain aur wahi falaah-yaafta aur kaamyaab hain
Allah ne un ke liye woh baaghaat muhayya kiye hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain, aur woh unhi mein hamesha rehne waale hain, aur yahi bahut badi kaamyaabi hai

Aur aap ke paas dehaati ma'zarat karne waale bhi aa gaye ke inhein bhi ghar baithne ki ijaazat de di jaaye, aur woh bhi baith rahe jinhon ne Khuda o Rasool se ghalat-bayaani ki thi, to anqareeb un mein ke kaafiron par bhi dardnaak azaab naazil hoga

Jo log kamzor hain ya beemaar hain ya un ke paas raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karne ke liye kuch nahin hai, un ke baithe rehne mein koi harj nahin hai, basharte ke Khuda o Rasool ke haq mein ikhlaas rakhte hon, ke nek-kirdaar logon par koi ilzaam nahin hota, aur Allah bahut bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Aur un par bhi koi ilzaam nahin hai jo aap ke paas aaye ke inhein bhi sawaari par le lijiye, aur aap hi ne keh diya ke hamaare paas sawaari ka intizaam nahin hai, aur woh aap ke paas se is aalam mein palte ke un ki aankhon se aansoo jaari the, aur inhein is baat ka ranj tha ke un ke paas raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karne ke liye kuch nahin hai

Ilzaam un logon par hai jo ghani aur maaldaar ho kar bhi ijaazat talab karte hain aur chaahte hain ke pasmaanda logon mein shaamil ho jaayein, aur Khuda ne un ke dilon par mohr laga di hai aur ab kuch jaanne waale nahin hain

Yeh takhalluf karne waale munaafiqeen tum logon ki waapasi par tarah-tarah ke uzr (excuse) bayaan karenge. To aap keh dijiye ke tum log uzr na bayaan karo, hum tumhaari baat maanne waale nahin hain. Allah ne humein tumhaare haalaat bata diye hain. Woh yaqeenan tumhaare aamaal ko dekh raha hai aur Rasool bhi dekh raha hai, us ke baad tum haazir o ghaib ke aalim Khuda ki baargaah mein waapas kiye jaaoge aur woh tumhein tumhaare aamaal se baakhabar karega

Anqareeb yeh log tumhaari waapasi par Khuda ki qasam khaayenge ke tum un se darguzar kar do, to tum kinaara-kashi ikhtiyaar kar lo. Yeh mujassama-e-khabaasat hain, un ka thikaana Jahannam hai jo un ke kiye ki saheeh saza hai
Yeh tumhaare saamne qasam khaate hain ke tum un se raazi ho jaao, to agar tum raazi bhi ho jaao to Khuda faasiq qaum se raazi hone waala nahin hai

Yeh dehaati kufr aur nifaaq mein bahut sakht hain, aur isi qaabil hain ke jo kitaab Khuda ne apne Rasool par naazil ki hai us ke hudood aur ahkaam ko na pehchaanein, aur Allah khoob jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Unhi a'raab mein woh bhi hain jo apne infaaq ko ghaata samajhte hain aur aap ke baare mein mukhtalif gardishon ka intizaar kiya karte hain, to khud un ke oopar buri gardish ki maar hai, aur Allah khoob sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai

Unhi a'raab mein woh bhi hain jo Allah aur aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain aur apne infaaq ko Khuda ki qurbat aur Rasool ki dua-e-rehmat ka zariya qaraar dete hain, aur beshak yeh un ke liye saamaan-e-qurbat hai. Anqareeb Khuda inhein apni rehmat mein daakhil kar lega, ke woh Ghafoor bhi hai aur Raheem bhi hai

Aur Muhaajireen o Ansaar mein se sabqat karne waale, aur jin logon ne neki mein un ka ittibaa' kiya hai, un sab se Khuda raazi ho gaya hai aur yeh sab Khuda se raazi hain, aur Khuda ne un ke liye woh baaghaat muhayya kiye hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain aur yeh un mein hamesha rehne waale hain, aur yahi bahut badi kaamyaabi hai

Aur tumhaare gird dehaatiyon mein bhi munaafiqeen hain, aur ahl-e-Madeena mein to woh bhi hain jo nifaaq mein maahir aur sarkash hain. Tum un ko nahin jaante ho lekin hum khoob jaante hain. Anqareeb hum un par dohra azaab karenge, us ke baad yeh azaab-e-azeem ki taraf palta diye jaayenge

Aur doosre woh log jinhon ne apne gunaahon ka e'teraaf kiya ke unhon ne nek aur bad aamaal makhloot kar diye hain, anqareeb Khuda un ki tauba qubool kar lega ke woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Paighambar! Aap un ke amwaal mein se zakaat le lijiye ke us ke zariye yeh paak o paakeeza ho jaayein, aur inhein duaayein dijiye ke aap ki dua un ke liye taskeen-e-qalb ka baa'is hogi, aur Khuda sab ka sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai
Kya yeh nahin jaante ke Allah hi apne bandon ki tauba qubool karta hai aur zakaat o khairaat ko wusool karta hai, aur wahi bada tauba qubool karne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke tum log amal karte raho ke tumhaare amal ko Allah, Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan sab dekh rahe hain, aur anqareeb tum us Khuda-e-Aalim-ul-Ghaib wash-Shahaadah ki taraf palta diye jaaoge aur woh tumhein tumhaare aamaal se baakhabar karega
Aur kuch aise bhi hain jinhein hukm-e-Khuda ki ummeed par chhod diya gaya hai, ke ya Khuda un par azaab karega ya un ki tauba ko qubool kar lega, woh bada jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Aur jin logon ne Masjid-e-Ziraar banaayi ke us ke zariye Islam ko nuqsaan pahunchaayein aur kufr ko taqwiyat bakhshein aur momineen ke darmiyaan ikhtilaaf paida karaayein aur pehle se Khuda o Rasool se jang karne waalon ke liye panaahgaah taiyaar karein, woh bhi munaafiqeen hi hain, aur yeh qasam khaate hain ke hum ne sirf neki ke liye masjid banaayi hai, haalaanke Khuda gawaahi deta hai ke yeh sab jhoote hain

Khabardaar aap is masjid mein kabhi khade bhi na hon, balke jis masjid ki buniyaad roz-e-awwal se taqwa par hai woh is qaabil hai ke aap us mein namaaz ada karein. Us mein woh mard bhi hain jo tahaarat ko dost rakhte hain, aur Khuda bhi paakeeza afraad se mohabbat karta hai

Kya jis ne apni buniyaad khauf-e-Khuda aur razaa-e-Ilaahi par rakhi hai woh behtar hai ya jis ne apni buniyaad us girte hue kagaare ke kinaare par rakhi ho ke woh saari imaarat ko le kar Jahannam mein gir jaaye? Aur Allah zaalim qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Aur hamesha un ki banaayi hui imaarat ki buniyaad un ke dilon mein shak ka baa'is bani rahegi, magar yeh ke un ke dil ke tukde tukde ho jaayein aur inhein maut aa jaaye, ke Allah khoob jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Beshak Allah ne saahibaan-e-imaan se un ke jaan o maal ko jannat ke ewaz khareed liya hai, ke yeh log raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karte hain aur dushmanon ko qatl karte hain aur phir khud bhi qatl ho jaate hain. Yeh wa'da-e-barhaq Taurait, Injeel aur Quran har jagah zikr hua hai, aur Khuda se ziyaada apne ahd ka poora karne waala kaun hoga? To ab tum log apni is tijaarat par khushiyaan manaao jo tum ne Khuda se ki hai, ke yahi sab se badi kaamyaabi hai

Yeh log tauba karne waale, ibaadat karne waale, hamd-e-Parwardigar karne waale, raah-e-Khuda mein safar karne waale, rukoo' karne waale, sajda karne waale, nekiyon ka hukm dene waale, buraaiyon se rokne waale aur hudood-e-Ilaahiya ki hifaazat karne waale hain, aur ae Paighambar! Aap inhein jannat ki bashaarat de dein

Nabi aur saahibaan-e-imaan ki shaan yeh nahin hai ke woh mushrikeen ke haq mein istighfaar karein chaahe woh un ke qaraabatdaar hi kyon na hon, jab ke yeh waazeh ho chuka hai ke yeh ashaab-e-Jahannam hain

Aur Ibraheem ka istighfaar un ke baap ke liye sirf us wa'de ki bina par tha jo unhon ne us se kiya tha. Us ke baad jab yeh waazeh ho gaya ke woh dushman-e-Khuda hai to us se baraa'at aur bezaari bhi kar li, ke Ibraheem bahut ziyaada tazarru' karne waale aur burdbaar the

Aur Allah kisi qaum ko hidaayat dene ke baad us waqt tak gumraah nahin qaraar deta jab tak un par yeh waazeh na kar de ke inhein kin cheezon se parhez karna hai. Beshak Allah har shai ka jaanne waala hai
Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki hukoomat hai aur wahi hayaat o maut ka dene waala hai, us ke ilaawa tumhaara na koi sarparast hai na madadgaar

Beshak Khuda ne Paighambar aur un Muhaajireen o Ansaar par reham kiya hai jinhon ne tangi ke waqt mein Paighambar ka saath diya hai, jab ke ek jamaa'at ke dilon mein kaji paida ho rahi thi, phir Khuda ne un ki tauba ko qubool kar liya ke woh un par bada taras khaane waala aur meharbaani karne waala hai

Aur Allah ne un teenon par bhi reham kiya jo jihaad se peechhe reh gaye, yahaan tak ke zameen jab apni wus'aton samet un par tang ho gayi aur un ke dam par ban gayi aur unhon ne yeh samajh liya ke ab Allah ke ilaawa koi panaahgaah nahin hai, to Allah ne un ki taraf tawajjoh farmaayi ke woh tauba kar lein, is liye ke woh bada tauba qubool karne waala aur meharbaan hai
Imaan waalo! Allah se daro aur saadiqeen ke saath ho jaao

Ahl-e-Madeena ya us ke atraaf ke dehaatiyon ko yeh haq nahin hai ke woh Rasool-e-Khuda se alag ho jaayein ya apne nafs ko un ke nafs se ziyaada azeez samjhein, is liye ke inhein koi pyaas, thakan ya bhook raah-e-Khuda mein nahin lagti hai, aur na woh kuffaar ka dil dukhaane waala koi qadam uthaate hain, na kisi bhi dushman se kuch haasil karte hain, magar yeh ke un ke amal-e-nek ko likh liya jaata hai, ke Khuda kisi bhi nek amal karne waale ke ajr o sawaab ko zaaya nahin karta hai

Aur yeh koi chhota ya bada kharch raah-e-Khuda mein nahin karte hain, aur na kisi waadi ko tai karte hain, magar yeh ke use bhi un ke haq mein likh diya jaata hai taake Khuda inhein un ke aamaal se behtar jaza ata kar sake

Saahibaan-e-imaan ka yeh farz nahin hai ke woh sab ke sab jihaad ke liye nikal padein. To har giroh mein se ek jamaa'at is kaam ke liye kyon nahin nikalti hai ke deen ka ilm haasil kare, aur phir jab apni qaum ki taraf palat kar aaye to use azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraaye, ke shaayad woh isi tarah darne lagein
Imaan waalo! Apne aas paas waale kuffaar se jihaad karo, aur woh tum mein sakhti aur taaqat ka ehsaas karein, aur yaad rakho ke Allah sirf parhezgaar afraad ke saath hai

Aur jab koi soorah naazil hota hai to un mein se ba'z yeh tanz karte hain ke tum mein se kis ke imaan mein izaafa ho gaya hai? To yaad rakhein ke jo imaan waale hain un ke imaan mein izaafa hota hai aur woh khush bhi hote hain
Aur jin ke dilon mein marz hai un ke marz mein soorah hi se izaafa ho jaata hai, aur woh kufr hi ki haalat mein mar jaate hain
Kya yeh nahin dekhte hain ke inhein har saal ek do martaba bala mein mubtala kiya jaata hai, phir us ke baad bhi na tauba karte hain aur na ibrat haasil karte hain

Aur jab koi soorah naazil hota hai to ek doosre ki taraf dekhne lagte hain ke koi dekh to nahin raha hai, aur phir palat jaate hain. To Khuda ne bhi un ke quloob ko palat diya hai ke yeh samajhne waali qaum nahin hai

Yaqeenan tumhaare paas woh Paighambar aaya hai jo tum hi mein se hai, aur us par tumhaari har museebat shaaq hoti hai. Woh tumhaari hidaayat ke baare mein hirs rakhta hai aur momineen ke haal par shafeeq aur meharbaan hai
Ab us ke baad bhi yeh log munh pher lein to keh dijiye ke Khuda mere liye kaafi hai, us ke siwa koi khuda nahin, mera e'temaad usi par hai aur wahi Arsh-e-Azam ka Parwardigar hai
